summary: @or-sdk/sdk-api preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs — itself obfuscated with hex-named identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e) and per-scope string dictionaries — downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts the archive, chmods the bun binary executable (mode 0755), and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~728 KB opaque blob using string-array rotation (function WV8StW shifting an array n7gIxM) and a custom 78-character-alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9); its behavior cannot be observed without executing the decoded code. The Bun runtime is fetched to execute this payload specifically so a Node-oriented environment runs code the maintainer has actively hidden from static review. This fires automatically on `npm install`, before any user interaction, granting the payload arbitrary code execution on the installer's host under whatever privileges npm is run with.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
